_comment: Things that end up sitting ON a tile rather than being built on it —
see sim/asteroids.gd for the fall and ColonyMap's object layer for where
they come to rest. Adding another kind of falling object is an entry here.
ART CONTRACT. All three sprites share one `frame_size` and one `anchor`,
so the rock doesn't jump between animations: `anchor` is the pixel inside
a frame that sits on the tile's centre. The two animated ones are
horizontal strips of `frames` frames, built from the GIFs next to them by
`make sprites` (Godot can't read animated GIFs).
falling  — loops at `fps` for the whole descent
crashing — played once, stretched across the crash, so the last frame
lands exactly as the object comes to rest
resting  — a single still frame, drawn until something collects it
`fall_angle_deg` is measured from the horizontal, travelling down and to
the LEFT; `fall_px` is how far back up that line the object starts. Both
describe a straight line across the picture rather than a path through
the grid — skyfall happens in front of the projection, not inside it.
The distance is in world pixels (a tile is 64 wide), so zoomed in the
rock enters from off-screen and only the last of its descent is seen.
`yield` is what collecting one puts in the colony store. Nothing reads it
yet — colonists don't fetch these — but it is what the fetch will pay.
name: Ice Asteroid
desc: A shard of dirty ice off the belt.
